conditions: Free particle in special relativity; E is total energy on the positive-energy branch, p is momentum magnitude, m is nonnegative invariant mass, measured in compatible units.
spoken_aliases: e squared equals p squared times c squared plus m squared times c to the fourth power
total energy squared equals momentum magnitude squared times the speed of light squared plus invariant mass squared times the speed of light to the fourth power

evidence: The invariant squared norm of four-momentum in the (+---) metric is m^2 c^2. Writing its time component E/c and spatial part p gives E^2/c^2-|p|^2=m^2 c^2. Multiply by c^2 and rearrange. The massless case reduces to E=pc on the positive-energy branch.
Reference checked 2026-11-27: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-3/pages/6-key-equations. Proposed maintainer approval, not independent human certification.
